_doc: Wave 19D combat takes for NVIDIA Kimodo (tools/roster/kimodo-combat/README in tools/roster/README.md). name -> prompt, seconds (multiple of 0.5), seeds tried, in_place (kimodo_clip_pipeline --in-place), loop (seconds, --loop). Prompts keep the arms clear of the big roster heads where they can. take: the accepted seed (kimodo_roster/<Name>/takes/<Name>_<take>.bvh, run through kimodo_clip_pipeline.py --tag w19); null = rejected.

clips.name: Sword_Slash_R
clips.prompt: A person holding a sword in the right hand raises it beside the right shoulder and slashes it diagonally down and across to the left in one fast stroke, then returns to a ready stance.
clips.alt: A person swings a sword with the right hand in a big diagonal slash from upper right to lower left.

clips.name: Sword_Slash_L
clips.prompt: A person holding a sword in the right hand brings it back by the left hip and swings a fast backhand slash across the body to the right, then returns to a ready stance.
clips.alt: A person swings a sword with the right hand in a backhand slash from left to right across the body.

clips.name: Sword_Thrust
clips.prompt: A person lunges forward and thrusts a sword straight ahead with the right arm fully extended, then pulls back into a ready stance.
clips.alt: A person steps forward with the right foot and stabs straight ahead with the right hand, then steps back.

clips.name: Sword_Parry
clips.prompt: A person quickly raises the right forearm out in front and to the right side to deflect a strike, then lowers it.
clips.alt: A person swings the right arm outward from the center to the right side to brush aside an attack, then returns to a ready stance.
rejected: A person holding a sword in the right hand quickly sweeps it up and across in front of the chest to knock aside a blow, then lowers it back to a ready stance.
A person raises the right hand quickly to block an attack in front of them, then lowers it.
clips.note: rejected after the pipeline (review.png): both forearms come up in front of the face and the hands sink into Hyptile's head; reads as a cover-up, not a blade sweep (AnimDef Parry stays)

clips.name: Axe_Chop
clips.prompt: A person lifts a heavy axe with both hands up above the right shoulder and chops it down hard in front of them, bending forward, then straightens up.
clips.alt: A person swings an axe with both hands from above the shoulder down to the ground in front of them, like chopping wood.

clips.name: Harpoon_Thrust
clips.prompt: A person holding a long spear with both hands at the waist lunges forward and stabs it straight ahead, then pulls it back to the waist.
clips.alt: A person stabs forward with a long pole held in both hands, then pulls it back.

clips.name: Harpoon_Throw
clips.prompt: A person draws a spear back beside the right shoulder with the right hand and hurls it forward hard, stepping into the throw.
clips.alt: A person throws a javelin forward with the right arm.

clips.name: Throw_Overhand
clips.prompt: A person throws a ball overhand with the right arm, stepping forward with the left foot and following through.
clips.alt: A person throws a heavy object forward overhand with the right hand.

clips.name: Pistol_Fire
clips.prompt: A person stands with the right arm stretched straight out in front at shoulder height, then the forearm snaps up sharply as if a pistol fired, and the arm lowers back to point ahead.
clips.alt: A person points the right arm forward, the hand jerks upward suddenly, then points forward again.
rejected: A person aims a pistol straight ahead with the right arm extended and fires, the arm kicking up from the recoil, then aims again.
A person points the right arm straight ahead like shooting a gun and jerks the hand up from the recoil.
clips.note: rejected after the pipeline (review.png): the aim arm rises into the Clown's cap and face; no recoil in any seed (GunPose Gun_Fire_Pistol stays)

clips.name: Rifle_Aim_Idle
clips.prompt: A person stands still aiming a rifle held against the right shoulder with both hands, the left hand under the barrel, looking along it.
clips.alt: A person holds a rifle up to the shoulder with both hands and aims it forward, standing still.
clips.note: rejected after the pipeline (review.png): the hands sit inside the face on Hyptile and the Clown (a human cheek weld on a big head; GunPose Gun_Aim_Musket stays)

clips.name: Rifle_Reload
clips.prompt: A person holds the left hand in front of the chest and with the right hand repeatedly pushes down from above the left hand toward the waist, two times.
clips.alt: A person pumps the right hand up and down in front of the body twice while the left hand stays still in front of the chest.
rejected: A person holds a long musket upright in front of them with the left hand and pushes a ramrod down the barrel with the right hand twice.
A person holds a long gun upright in front of them and pushes something down into the barrel with the right hand.
clips.note: rejected: no take rams; every seed of both prompt rounds holds an aim or stands still (GunPose Gun_Reload stays)

clips.name: Blunderbuss_Fire
clips.prompt: A person holds both hands in front of the belly as if gripping a heavy gun, then is jolted backward by a blast, taking a step back, and recovers.
clips.alt: A person standing with both hands held at the waist is suddenly pushed backward by a strong force, staggers one step back and steadies.
rejected: A person braces with feet wide apart, holds a heavy gun at the waist with both hands and fires, rocking back from the strong recoil.
A person holds a gun with both hands at the hip, fires it and is pushed back by the recoil.
clips.note: rejected: round 1 holds a static aim, round 2 doubles over forward instead of rocking back (GunPose Gun_Fire_Musket stays)

clips.name: Club_Swing
clips.prompt: A person raises a short club in the right hand and strikes down hard in front of them, then returns to a ready stance.
clips.alt: A person swings a club with the right hand down and across in front of them.

clips.name: Dodge_Roll
clips.prompt: A person crouches, dives forward into a quick roll over the shoulder and comes back up onto their feet.
clips.alt: A person does a forward roll on the ground and stands back up.

clips.name: Block_Hit
clips.prompt: A person holding both forearms up in front of the chest is struck hard, knocked back half a step, and raises the guard again.
clips.alt: A person guards their face with both arms, gets hit and staggers back a step, then guards again.
clips.note: rejected on the seed sheet (preview_takes): every seed of both prompts guards with the hands at the face, which sank into the big heads in Rifle_Aim_Idle / Sword_Parry; not run through the pipeline (AnimDef Block_Impact stays)

clips.name: Taunt
clips.prompt: A person beckons an enemy forward with one hand, then thumps their chest with a fist, taunting.
clips.alt: A person waves an opponent over with the hand, then beats their chest, taunting.
